featured.title: [Pre-RFC] BTF relocations
featured.summary:

Can a relocation affect the number of pointer dereferences necessary to access a field?

featured.reason: Potential impact on Rust's type system
featured.suggestedSummary: A series of discussions on the Rust Internals forum introduces a pre-RFC for BTF (BPF Type Format) relocations, proposing a new #[btf_preserve_access] attribute. This change aims to improve the compatibility of Rust with BPF (Berkeley Packet Filter) targets by preserving access to aggregate types during compilation. The proposal could significantly impact how Rust handles type layouts, especially in systems programming contexts where BPF is heavily utilized.

featured.title: Build Security
featured.summary:
The primary obstacle to getting sandboxing into Cargo (for build scripts) and rustc (for proc-macros) is implementing it (or at least prototyping it), not convincing people that it should be done.
Sandboxing is already an accepted Major Change Proposal. You can use host.runner to experimentally plug in your choice of sandbox to Cargo build script execution. What this problem needs is people working on implementing solutions and seeing how well they work in practice.
featured.suggestedSummary: The Rust community is actively discussing methods to enhance build security, focusing on sandboxing build scripts and proc-macros. Ideas include using Wasm for sandboxing and adding configuration options to standard libraries to prevent unsafe operations. These changes aim to protect Rust projects from potential vulnerabilities introduced during the build process, ensuring safer and more reliable software development.

quickNews.title: Egui_tracing 0.3 — a live tracing/log viewer widget for egui apps
quickNews.summary:
Hi all,
I wanted to share egui_tracing, a small crate that gives any egui/eframe app an embedded log viewer. You register it as a tracing_subscriber layer once at startup, then drop a Logs widget anywhere in your UI and get filtering by level, filtering by target (with glob patterns), search, and a scrollable event list — both on native and wasm32.
It also bridges the log crate, so crates that haven't migrated to tracing still show up.

quickNews.title: 【Rust日报】2026-04-10 miro v0.8.0: 增加演示和全屏模式
quickNews.summary:
miro v0.8.0: 增加演示和全屏模式

miro 是一个使用 Rust 开发的 PDF 阅读器，它基于 iced 和 mupdf-rs 构建。此次 v0.8.0 增加了演示模式和全屏模式。
功能特性
深色模式（界面与 PDF 同步生效）
类 Vim 快捷键绑定（默认启用）
独立配置文件，可自定义快捷键（不喜欢 Vim 风格时使用）
鼠标操作支持
多标签页打开多个 PDF
支持命令行参数，可从终端直接打开 PDF
已打开 PDF 自动热重载（尤其适合编写 LaTeX、Typst 等可编译为 PDF 的文档时使用）
文档文本复制功能
内部链接跳转（如目录跳转）
外部链接支持（点击即可复制邮箱、网址等）
书签功能
跳转历史记录
可选 RPC 服务端，支持通过其他程序控制阅读器
调用系统默认浏览器打印
键盘快捷键打开链接
全屏模式
演示模式：隐藏全部界面元素
Github: https://github.com/vincent-uden/miro
